text: Register and sign in with an email address and a password, receiving an HTTP-only session cookie.
label: FR-1

text: Create a short link from a target URL while signed in, returning a code of at least seven characters.
label: FR-2

text: Redirect a request for a known, not-deleted code to its target URL with HTTP 302.
label: FR-3

text: List the signed-in member's own links on a console page, newest first, twenty per page. No other member's links appear.
label: FR-4

text: Delete one of the signed-in member's own links: the response is 204, a later request for that code returns 404, and the code is never reissued.
label: FR-5

text: Reject a target URL whose scheme is not `http` or `https`, whose host matches the configured `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, or whose host is `localhost` or an IP literal in a private (RFC1918), loopback, link-local, unique-local, or cloud-metadata (`169.254.169.254`) range. Inspect the host literally at creation time — no DNS lookup and no outbound fetch.
label: FR-6

text: Sign out invalidates the session server-side; a later authenticated request returns 401.
label: FR-7

text: Expose a `/healthz` endpoint that is 200 when the database is reachable and 503 when it is not.
label: FR-8

text: Create and list responses are p95 under 300 ms for an account holding 100 links.
label: NFR-1

text: Short codes are drawn from a cryptographically secure random source and carry at least 40 bits of entropy.
label: NFR-2

text: Passwords are stored using Argon2id and are never written to logs.
label: NFR-3

text: The console conforms to WCAG 2.2 level AA.
label: NFR-4

text: The system runs from one `docker compose up` with a single Postgres 16 container and no third-party network calls at build or run time.
label: NFR-5

text: When the database is unreachable the API returns HTTP 503 with a JSON error body and never a stack trace.
label: NFR-6
